source_invariants_preserved: no repair or stability inference from construction

choices.decision: Guard all public value construction; own coordinates and return no usable value on failure.
choices.alternative_or_limit: An unguarded data record is rejected as the target design; cannot enforce invariants.
choices.reopen_when: Reopen when the OO boundary is formally incorporated or a required native representation changes.
choices.status: proposed; tested externally; not accepted product authority

choices.decision: Use numeric arrays for standalone bits and ASCII nine-character strings for existing snapshot/trace fields.
choices.alternative_or_limit: Do not accept both representations indiscriminately at every field.
choices.reopen_when: Reopen on documented consumer compatibility evidence.
choices.status: proposed; tested externally; not accepted product authority

choices.decision: Accept exact numeric zero/one spellings; reject Boolean, text and fractional values; preserve precision before validation.
choices.alternative_or_limit: Lexically banning 1.0 would need a raw token grammar beyond ordinary schema semantics.
choices.reopen_when: Reopen on selected product JSON parser and canonical encoding policy.
choices.status: proposed; tested externally; not accepted product authority

choices.decision: Retain the descriptive required membership member as Boolean true, but recompute membership from bits.
choices.alternative_or_limit: Dropping membership requires an explicit migration; trusting it is prohibited. No claim that this Boolean was previously specified.
choices.reopen_when: Reopen on consumer inventory or explicit wire version/adoption decision.
choices.status: proposed; tested externally; not accepted product authority

choices.decision: Forbid unexpected members in these two small standalone value records.
choices.alternative_or_limit: Permissive extension handling would require a separately defined extension boundary.
choices.reopen_when: Reopen if a real consumer requires supported extension metadata.
choices.status: proposed; tested externally; not accepted product authority

choices.decision: Reject duplicate keys, malformed JSON, invalid UTF-8 and non-JSON constants.
choices.alternative_or_limit: Do not accept a parser silently discarding duplicate fields.
choices.reopen_when: Reopen on the approved engine-wide input policy.
choices.status: proposed; tested externally; not accepted product authority

choices.decision: Emit fixed-order compact UTF-8 records with integer coordinate tokens and no trailing newline.
choices.alternative_or_limit: Not a global JCS or canonical-JSON adoption; do not infer one.
choices.reopen_when: Reopen on an approved whole-engine canonical serialization profile.
choices.status: proposed; tested externally; not accepted product authority

choices.decision: Consumers must select the exact record schema/decoder; the root union is not proof of expected type.
choices.basis: Existing absence of universal discriminator in S02
choices.alternative_or_limit: Do not add a mandatory new discriminator or infer caller intent.
choices.status: proposed; tested externally; not accepted product authority

choices.decision: Use urn:ywe:review:ash-values:20260918:1 solely for this offline experiment.
choices.alternative_or_limit: No production namespace, registry installation or public endpoint is created.
choices.reopen_when: Replace during approved production schema registration.
